# dokku_app_json_property (Data Source)

Manages the app.json configuration for a given dokku application

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dokku_app_json_property" "example" {
  app      = "node-js-app"
  property = "appjson-path"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `property` (String) Name of the property to set

### Optional

- `app` (String) Name of the app
- `global` (Boolean) Flag indicating if the property should be applied globally

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The resource's identity address.
- `value` (String) Value to set for the property (required)
